en: Bounding-box rule: use the axis-aligned min/max coordinates of the target atoms and expand the box by 0.5 Å on all six sides; use the given Cartesian coordinates in Å and order [xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax].

Functional-group box atoms: use the chemically named core only, excluding substituent-neighbor atoms matched merely to establish connectivity. Core heavy atoms are: alcohol O; ether O; thioether S; amine N; ketone C=O; nitrile C≡N; amide/lactam N–C(=O); urea N–C(=O)–N; ester O–C(=O); carboxylic acid C(=O)–O; sulfone S(=O)₂; sulfonamide S(=O)₂–N; phosphate P with its four O atoms. Include all explicitly bonded hydrogens on the donor N/O core atoms; aldehyde core includes its aldehydic H.

Find every instance with the query SMARTS below. Each box encloses only the named core atoms, not substituent neighbors used to establish connectivity: alcohol/ether O, thioether S, amine N, ketone C=O, nitrile C≡N, amide/lactam N–C(=O), urea N–C(=O)–N, ester O–C(=O), acid C(=O)–O, sulfone S(=O)2, sulfonamide S(=O)2–N, phosphate P plus four O. Include explicit H bonded to donor N/O core atoms and aldehydic H; extend each min/max face by 0.5 Å. Distinct SMARTS instances remain separate even when sharing atoms; sort boxes by minimum source atom index. SMARTS: alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; amide=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1]); carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; ester=[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); ether=[OD2]([#6])[#6]; ketone=[#6][CX3](=O)[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; phosphate=[PX4](=O)([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2][CX4]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1]([CX4])[CX4]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([CX4])([CX4])[CX4]; thioether=[SX2]([#6])[#6]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]

官能团包围盒原子：只取所述官能团核心，排除仅用于确认连接方式的取代基邻原子。核心重原子：醇 O、醚 O、硫醚 S、胺 N、酮 C=O、腈 C≡N、酰胺/内酰胺 N–C(=O)、脲 N–C(=O)–N、酯 O–C(=O)、羧酸 C(=O)–O、砜 S(=O)₂、磺酰胺 S(=O)₂–N、磷酸基 P 及其四个 O。包含核心供体 N/O 上显式连接的全部 H；醛基还包含醛氢。

按下列查询 SMARTS 找到每个实例。每个盒仅包围命名核心原子，不含仅用于确认连接的取代基邻原子：醇/醚 O、硫醚 S、胺 N、酮 C=O、腈 C≡N、酰胺/内酰胺 N–C(=O)、脲 N–C(=O)–N、酯 O–C(=O)、羧酸 C(=O)–O、砜 S(=O)2、磺酰胺 S(=O)2–N、磷酸基 P 及四个 O。供体 N/O 核心显式连接的 H 和醛氢一并纳入；各面外扩 0.5 Å。共享原子的不同 SMARTS 实例仍分别成盒；按最小源原子索引排序。SMARTS：alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; amide=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1]); carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; ester=[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); ether=[OD2]([#6])[#6]; ketone=[#6][CX3](=O)[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; phosphate=[PX4](=O)([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2][CX4]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1]([CX4])[CX4]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([CX4])([CX4])[CX4]; thioether=[SX2]([#6])[#6]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]

长 sp3 碳链指至少 5 个连续的非环 sp3 碳原子组成的简单路径；环原子不得构成或连接该路径。
先报告芳香环数及 RDKit 氢键供体位点数/HBA 受体数，再仅筛查以下基准局部基序及潜在转化：N–C(=O) 酰胺键（包括脲/内酰胺及氨基甲酸酯中的相应键）和 O–C(=O) 酯键：潜在水解；普通叔胺：潜在 N-氧化或 N-脱烷基化；非羰基醚 O：潜在 O-脱烷基化；醇：潜在氧化或结合反应。统计各不同局部匹配；无上述基序则报告无。其他化学上可能的代谢反应不属于本固定筛查分类。
en: Long sp3 carbon chain means a continuous simple path of at least 5 non-ring sp3 carbon atoms. Ring atoms cannot form or connect this path.

Report aromatic-ring count and RDKit HBD donor-site/HBA acceptor counts, then only these benchmark-local motif classes and potential transformations: N–C(=O) amide edges (including urea/lactam and carbamate edges) and O–C(=O) ester edges: potential hydrolysis; ordinary tertiary amine: potential N-oxidation or N-dealkylation; non-carbonyl ether O: potential O-dealkylation; alcohol: potential oxidation or conjugation. Count distinct local matches; if no listed motif exists, report none. Other plausible metabolic chemistry is outside this fixed screening ontology.

Similarity coverage uses RDKit rdFMCS.FindMCS with completeRingsOnly=True on heavy-atom graphs. coverage_A = MCS heavy-atom count / heavy-atom count of molecule A. Classify close_analog if coverage_A>0.80; otherwise related_analog if coverage_A>0.60; otherwise not_close_analog.

zh: Pure2D grounding 返回原始 RDKit SMARTS 匹配中的全部原子，包括用于确认连接的相邻 C（与 3D 衍生任务的核心原子规则不同）。使用公开的重叠类别层级与叔胺共振失活排除规则；相同实例去重，组内索引升序，组间按最小索引排序。SMARTS：alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; aldehyde=[CX3H1](=O)[#6]; amide=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1]); carbamate=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[OX2]; carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; ester=[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); ether=[OD2]([#6;!$(C=O)])[#6;!$(C=O)]; halogen=[F,Cl,Br,I]; ketone=[#6][CX3](=O)[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; nitro=[NX3+](=O)[O-]; phenol=[OX2H]c; phosphate=[PX4](=O)([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)][#6]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)]([#6])[#6]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([#6])([#6])[#6]; thioether=[SX2;!$([SX2]-[CX3](=[O,S,N]))]([#6])[#6]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]
en: Pure2D grounding returns every atom in each original RDKit SMARTS match, including connectivity-checking C neighbors (unlike the 3D-derived core-atom tasks). Use the documented overlap hierarchy and tertiary-amine resonance exclusion; deduplicate identical matches, sort indices within groups and groups by the smallest index. SMARTS: alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; aldehyde=[CX3H1](=O)[#6]; amide=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1]); carbamate=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[OX2]; carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; ester=[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); ether=[OD2]([#6;!$(C=O)])[#6;!$(C=O)]; halogen=[F,Cl,Br,I]; ketone=[#6][CX3](=O)[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; nitro=[NX3+](=O)[O-]; phenol=[OX2H]c; phosphate=[PX4](=O)([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)][#6]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)]([#6])[#6]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([#6])([#6])[#6]; thioether=[SX2;!$([SX2]-[CX3](=[O,S,N]))]([#6])[#6]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]

en: Use the generator ontology: generic amide excludes carbonyl centers assigned urea, carbamate, or lactam; generic ester excludes carbamate and lactone. Cyclic urea/imide N–C(=O) edges assigned urea do not create independent lactam labels; cyclic carbamate is neither lactam nor lactone. The imine matcher is C=N ([CX3]=[NX2]). Ether excludes O adjacent to carbonyl carbon; thioether excludes S adjacent to C(=O/S/N); tertiary amine excludes resonance-deactivated N. Count only the queried class under this hierarchy. SMARTS candidates: acyl_halide=[CX3](=[OX1])[F,Cl,Br,I]; alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; aldehyde=[CX3H1](=O)[#6]; amide=[CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]; anhydride=[CX3](=[OX1])[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); carbamate=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[OX2]; carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; epoxide=[OX2r3]; ester=[CX3](=O)[OX2][#6]; ether=[OD2]([#6;!$(C=O)])[#6;!$(C=O)]; guanidine=[NX3][CX3](=[NX2])[NX3]; halogenated_aromatic=[cX3][F,Cl,Br,I]; heteroaromatic_ring=[nR]; imine=[CX3]=[NX2]; ketone=[CX3](=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); lactone=[OX2R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; nitro=[NX3+](=O)[O-]; phenol=[OX2H]c; phosphate=[PX4](=[OX1])([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)][#6]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)]([#6])[#6]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([#6])([#6])[#6]; thioether=[SX2;!$([SX2]-[CX3](=[O,S,N]))]([#6])[#6]; thiol=[SX2H]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]
zh: 采用生成器官能团分类：generic 酰胺排除已归为脲、氨基甲酸酯或内酰胺的羰基中心；generic 酯排除氨基甲酸酯和内酯。环脲/酰亚胺中已归为脲的 N–C(=O) 键不另计内酰胺；环状氨基甲酸酯既不另计内酰胺也不另计内酯。亚胺匹配 C=N（[CX3]=[NX2]）。醚排除与羰基碳相邻的 O；硫醚排除与 C(=O/S/N) 相邻的 S；叔胺排除共振失活的 N。按该层级只统计题目所问类别。候选 SMARTS：acyl_halide=[CX3](=[OX1])[F,Cl,Br,I]; alcohol=[OX2H][CX4]; aldehyde=[CX3H1](=O)[#6]; amide=[CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]; anhydride=[CX3](=[OX1])[OX2][CX3](=[OX1]); carbamate=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[OX2]; carboxylic_acid=[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; epoxide=[OX2r3]; ester=[CX3](=O)[OX2][#6]; ether=[OD2]([#6;!$(C=O)])[#6;!$(C=O)]; guanidine=[NX3][CX3](=[NX2])[NX3]; halogenated_aromatic=[cX3][F,Cl,Br,I]; heteroaromatic_ring=[nR]; imine=[CX3]=[NX2]; ketone=[CX3](=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; lactam=[NX3R][CX3R](=[OX1]); lactone=[OX2R][CX3R](=[OX1]); nitrile=[CX2]#[NX1]; nitro=[NX3+](=O)[O-]; phenol=[OX2H]c; phosphate=[PX4](=[OX1])([OX2])([OX2])[OX2]; primary_amine=[NX3H2;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)][#6]; secondary_amine=[NX3H1;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S(=O)=O)]([#6])[#6]; sulfonamide=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([NX3]); sulfone=[SX4](=[OX1])(=[OX1])([#6])[#6]; tertiary_amine=[NX3H0]([#6])([#6])[#6]; thioether=[SX2;!$([SX2]-[CX3](=[O,S,N]))]([#6])[#6]; thiol=[SX2H]; urea=[NX3][CX3](=[OX1])[NX3]

zh: 标志：亲脂–芳香 = cLogP>3 且芳香环≥2；否则 cLogP>4 记作高 cLogP；长 sp³ 碳链 = 由连续≥5 个非环 sp³ 碳原子组成的简单路径，路径内每个原子均须不属于任何环（RDKit IsInRing() 为 false）；环原子不得构成或连接该路径；另检测酯基与芳基胺。符合亲脂–芳香时不重复高 cLogP。

仅报告以下五类固定基准标志，而非开放式代谢位点：cLogP>3 且芳香环数≥2 为亲脂–芳香；否则 cLogP>4 为高 cLogP；至少五个连续非环 sp3 碳组成简单路径（路径每个原子 IsInRing 为 false）为长 sp3 碳链；[CX3](=O)[OX2][#6] 匹配为酯；芳基胺要求非芳香 N 以单键直接连在全碳芳香环的芳香 C 上，且排除含双键的 N、连接 O/N/P/S 邻原子的 N 及与邻近 C/P/S=O/N/S 共振失活的 N。已有亲脂–芳香时不重复高 cLogP。均无则回答无。
en: Flags: lipophilic-aromatic = cLogP>3 and ≥2 aromatic rings; otherwise high-cLogP = cLogP>4. Long sp³-carbon-chain = a simple continuous path of ≥5 non-ring sp³ carbon atoms; every atom in the path must be outside all rings (RDKit IsInRing() is false). Ring atoms cannot form or connect this path. Also detect ester and aryl-amine motifs. Do not repeat high-cLogP if lipophilic-aromatic applies.

Report only these five fixed benchmark flags, not open-ended metabolic sites: lipophilic–aromatic if cLogP>3 and aromatic rings>=2; otherwise high-cLogP if cLogP>4; long sp3-carbon-chain if a simple path of at least five consecutive non-ring sp3 carbon atoms exists (all path atoms IsInRing false); ester if [CX3](=O)[OX2][#6] matches; aryl-amine if a nonaromatic N is single-bonded to aromatic carbon in an all-carbon aromatic ring, excluding N with double bonds, O/N/P/S neighbors, or resonance deactivation by neighboring C/P/S=O/N/S. Do not repeat high-cLogP when lipophilic–aromatic applies. If none, answer none.
Lipinski exceedances: MW>500, cLogP>5, HBD>5, HBA>10.
zh: Lipinski 超限：MW>500、cLogP>5、HBD>5、HBA>10。

en: TPSA bins (Å²): low <60, moderate 60–<90, elevated 90–<140, high ≥140. cLogP bins: low <1, intermediate 1–<4, high ≥4.

en: Similarity uses RDKit 2024.03.5 Morgan bit fingerprints (radius=2, fpSize=2048, no chirality) with Tanimoto similarity. Coverage uses RDKit rdFMCS.FindMCS with completeRingsOnly=True and default element/bond-order matching: coverage_A=MCS heavy atoms/heavy atoms in A, coverage_B analogously, symmetric coverage=min(coverage_A,coverage_B). Classify close_analog if Tanimoto≥0.65, symmetric coverage>0.80, and the change is confined to one atom or one substitution site; otherwise related_analog if Tanimoto≥0.50 and symmetric coverage>0.60; otherwise not_close_analog.
zh: 相似度采用 RDKit 2024.03.5 Morgan 位指纹（radius=2，fpSize=2048，不使用手性）及 Tanimoto。覆盖率采用 RDKit rdFMCS.FindMCS（completeRingsOnly=True，默认元素/键级匹配）：coverage_A=MCS 重原子数/A 的重原子数，coverage_B 同理，对称覆盖率=min(coverage_A,coverage_B)。Tanimoto≥0.65、对称覆盖率>0.80 且差异仅限一个原子或一个取代位点时为 close_analog；否则 Tanimoto≥0.50 且对称覆盖率>0.60 为 related_analog；其余为 not_close_analog。
